newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney starts wireless cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney starts wireless cos.

text.p: -- Smith Barney said analyst Thomas Lee initiated coverage of the wireless service industry.
-- said initiated coverage of 360 Communications Co with a buy rating.
-- said believes 360 Comms can easily generate new revenue streams, incrementally adding to the 35 percent plus growth of its core cellular business.
-- set 360 Comms 12-month target price $40.
-- said initiated coverage of Western Wireless Corp and Omnipoint Corp with outperfrom ratings.
-- said Western Wireless has optimal mix of rural cellular and urban personal communications services assets, as well as a solid financial position.
-- said Western's rural cellular assets continue to grow faster than the industry.
-- set Western 12-month target price $29.
-- said Omnipoint owns "some of the most attractive and dense wireless licenses in the U.S."
-- sees material subscriber growth to occur in second to third quarter of 1997.
-- set 12-month target price $31.
-- said initiated coverage of AirTouch Communications Inc , Palmer Wireless Inc, Vanguard Cellular Systems Inc and Aerial Communications Inc with neutral ratings.
-- said AirTouch owns a premiere collection of domestic cellular and personal communications services (PCS) assets and international cellular assets.
-- said AirTouch earnings and stock faces potential dilution from its buyout of U S West's interest in their cellular partnership.
-- said competition from PCS on AirTouch's domestic cellular systems should accelerate in 1997.
-- said believes Palmer has been for sale since early February.
-- said company has attractive middle-sized markets.
-- said stock is expensive and given Palmer's already efficient operations, Palmer does not offer an acquirer immediate cost saving opportunities.
-- said Vanguard has attractive middle markets and "hidden" asset values, but has shown continued disappointing operating results.
-- said Aerial has not yet rolled out full commercial service in its six major markets.
-- said could see visible subscriber results after the third quarter of 1997.
